SportyBet completely locked me out of their platform, preventing me from accessing my own money while games were in progress. There was no prior warning, no clear explanation, and no reasonable support to resolve the issue quickly. As soon as the games were over, their site returned to normal. This is an act of criminality and fraud against customers who trusted their hard-earned money to this company.

As a customer, you expect transparency and fair treatment especially when it comes to your funds. Locking users out without proper communication seriously damages trust. Customer support was slow and unhelpful, making the situation even more frustrating.
